basis_definition: deterioration = (F_exit-S_exit)-(F_entry-S_entry); normalize by first native mark solely as a reference scale, not an executable entry. Strictly positive conditional cash requires deterioration_bps below the recorded frontier.
classification: one-use exploratory retained-data full-hedge break-even frontier, not independent validation
cost_rule: Predetermined sensitivities, not native rates. Noncapital reserve is all-in cash relative to reference, not a fee percentage on each changing execution notional. Two times reference is an illustrative budget, not venue margin recognition or capital sufficiency. Zero costs provide only a conditional optimistic bound. Real execution/latency/slippage/borrow/fee-asset and residual-inventory costs must enter actual all-in costs before any admission.
failure_rule: Any byte, row-count, exact symbol, native value, chronology or window mismatch rejects all panels. Retain terminal failure and do not edit the consumed contract or rerun. A valid calculation does not authorize quotes or account requests.
funding_drawdown_rule: Funding-only cumulative prefund and drawdown begin at zero after excluded reference payment. They are not hedge drawdown, continuous collateral requirement, account solvency or portfolio risk.
holding_rule: Equal net base quantities, one base unit long spot and one base unit short linear perpetual. Exclude the first native event in each panel: observing its mark does not earn its payment. Assume all later supplied events HELD only for the conditional case; additionally report UNKNOWN entitlement bounds. No actual position, quantity, fee asset or owned payment is inferred.
missing_evidence: executable equal-net-base entry and exit cash and quantities
basis deterioration bound or measured path
continuous isolated margin liquidation ADL custody and operational risk
cash-qualified chronological untouched regimes and stable repeatable capacity
population_rule: All three symbols and all five predetermined panels; full period followed by four contiguous eight-day panels. Subpanels overlap the full panel and are not independent observations or out-of-sample confirmation. No selection, calibration, fit, optimization, rolling extension or adaptive cost change after access.
question: For all three retained native September 5-October 6 major-asset series, what funding cash can a hypothetical fixed equal-base hedge devote to the combined change in executable hedge basis, all noncapital costs and explicit capital cost? No observed hedge-return or stability claim.
reference_rule: First supplied funding mark per panel is a scale reference only. No trade at that mark is assumed. Capital accrual lasts from that exact millisecond through the exclusive calendar end. Preserve all native millisecond offsets.
